name: Zytka

facts.text: World's End holds three octonoid mothers on its shore, each spawning young octonoids: Balere, Mollunero and Zytka.
Zytka: level 66, 30,000 health, five or six young, a tether of 2,600.

story: Zytka is the youngest of the three mothers and the most restless. Her brood is smaller than her sisters' and she moves about the shore more, a little further every season, as if looking for shallows of her own. The Sylvan fishers say she will be the worst of them in a hundred years. For now she is only dangerous, which on the World's End shore counts as a mercy. Her young are fewer, but they are quick, and they go for whoever is standing in the surf.
legend: The smallest brood of the three, five or six young: AoE them, then her. She walks home if dragged far. A good group can do her; a careless one wakes Balere's brood too, and then it is two mothers and twenty arms.

aggro: The youngest mother lifts her arms.

phases.text: Zytka's young come curling up the rocks.

lairEntry: Fresh tracks on the shore, wandering.

phases.text: Zytka's brood slides out of the surf!
